useWhen: An operator hands over Sentry envelopes, event exports or /events/ responses and asks which errors to look at first
avoidWhen: Resolving or muting issues in a live Sentry project, or treating mihari priority as Sentry priority

inputs.context: release and environment the operator cares about

outputs.triage: grouped issues with priority, regression flags and the evidence counts behind them

authority.binding: caller authorization; the mcp server must be enabled in the profile by its owner

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 709c948, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. The steps call MCP tools by their itonami-agent names (mcp__<server>__<tool>) and assume the server key in mcp_servers matches the entry id.
